fusions.name: Split Harmony
fusions.desc: Looses 2 notes at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage.

fusions.name: Two-Throated Call
fusions.desc: Sends a booming call that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1.2 seconds, then forks to 1 more enemy within 5 tiles for 80% of the damage.

fusions.name: Doubled Breath
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You gain +10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Either Current
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
